text: Why did the cat join the band? | It wanted to be the purr-cussionist.
Why did the snail paint its shell red? | It wanted to look fast.
What do you call a cow that plays the drums? | A moo-sician.
Why was the owl a great teacher? | It always gave a hoot about the class.
Why did the frog get the job? | It was always ready to jump at a chance.
Why did the dog sit in the shade? | It did not want to turn into a hot dog.
What do you call a sleepy dinosaur? | A dino-snore.
Why do bees have sticky hair? | They use honeycombs.
What did the penguin say when it got a new fridge? | That is cool.
Why was the elephant bad at hide and seek? | It kept leaving trunk prints.
What do you call a fish that wears a bowtie? | So-fish-ticated.
Why did the chicken join the orchestra? | It was great with drumsticks.
What do you call a bear with no teeth? | A gummy bear.
Why did the spider get a computer? | To build a better website.
What did the sheep say after a haircut? | That was a shear delight.
Why did the monkey bring a clock to the tree? | It wanted to hang out on time.
What do you call a horse that lives next door? | A neigh-bor.
What do you call a turtle that flies? | A shell-copter.
What do ducks do when the show is over? | They take a quack bow.
Why are fish so smart? | They live in schools.
What is a cat's favorite color? | Purr-ple.
Why was the giraffe the star of the party? | Everyone looked up to it.
Why did the pony cough? | It was a little horse.
What do you call a rabbit that tells jokes? | A funny bunny.
Why was the bat a good singer? | It could always find the right pitch.
Why did the pencil go to the party? | It was a sharp dresser.
Why was the math book sad? | It had too many problems.
Why did the ruler win the contest? | It was the best at measuring up.
Why did the student eat her homework? | The teacher said it was a piece of cake.
Why did the clock go to school? | It was tired of being a few seconds behind.
Why did the eraser get a medal? | It was great at fixing mistakes.
Why did the book go to the doctor? | It had a sore spine.
Why is the library so quiet? | Every book is keeping a secret.
What did the board say to the chalk? | You always leave your mark.
Why was the glue the best friend in class? | It stuck with everyone.
Why did the globe get invited everywhere? | It was well traveled.
What did the scissors say to the paper? | Let us cut to the chase.
Why did the crayon blush? | It was caught red handed.
Why did the cloud get a ruler? | It wanted to measure the rain.
What do snowmen eat for breakfast? | Snowflakes.
What kind of music do snowflakes like? | Chill hop.
What did the kite say to the wind? | You really lift me up.
Why is thunder always late to the party? | Lightning gets there first.
What did one raindrop say to the other? | Let us drop by the puddle.
Why did the umbrella feel important? | It always had everyone covered.
What is a tornado's favorite game? | Twister.
What do clouds wear under their clothes? | Thunderwear.
What kind of tree fits in your hand? | A palm tree.
Why was the moon so full? | It had a big lunch.
How does the moon cut its hair? | Eclipse it.
Why did the astronaut break up with the star? | It needed some space.
What do planets like to read? | Comet books.
Why did the star go to school? | To become a little brighter.
What did the alien say to the garden? | Take me to your weeder.
Why did the rocket lose its job? | It got fired.
What is an astronaut's favorite part of the computer? | The space bar.
Why was the space party so quiet? | There was no atmosphere.
What do you call a star that tells jokes? | A comet-ian.
Why did the drummer bring a ladder? | To reach the high hat.
Why was the piano so lucky? | It always had the right keys.
What did the guitar say to the pick? | You always get to the point.
Why did the trumpet blush? | It was caught blowing its own horn.
Why did the violin win the game? | It had the best strings attached.
What is a musician's favorite kind of tea? | Treble tea.
Why did the music teacher go to the bank? | To get a few extra notes.
Why was the flute always calm? | It knew how to breathe through the notes.
Why was the band so good at math? | It knew how to count the beats.
Why did the singer carry a bucket? | To carry a tune.
Why did the spoon go to the concert? | It loved the stir-ring music.
What did the pot say to the kettle? | You look hot today.
Why did the pan stay home? | It was feeling flat.
What do you call a cup that sings? | A mug-ician.
Why did the fork go to school? | It wanted to be a bit sharper.
Why did the toaster get a trophy? | It was on a roll.
What did the plate say to the bowl? | Dinner is on me.
Why was the oven a good friend? | It always warmed up to people.
Why did the blender win the race? | It was great at mixing it up.
What did the fridge say to the freezer? | Chill out, I have this.
Why did the soup become an actor? | It was a natural at playing a stock character.
Why did the banana go to the doctor? | It was not peeling well.
Why did the grape stop in the road? | It ran out of juice.
Why was the cookie sad? | Its friends were all crumbs.
What did the tea say to the cup? | You hold me together.
Why did the tomato turn red? | It saw the salad dressing.
What is a pirate's favorite school subject? | Arrr-ithmetic.
What do you call a bike that cannot stand up? | Two tired.
What do you call a bus full of kittens? | A mew-nibus.
Why do trains never get lost? | They always stay on track.
Why did the boat go to the party? | It wanted to make a splash.
Why did the airplane get a sweater? | It was feeling a bit cloudy.
Why did the robot go to the beach? | To recharge its batteries.
What did the robot say to the cat? | Nice to mew you.
Why was the robot so calm? | It had nerves of steel.
Why did the computer wear glasses? | To improve its web sight.
Why was the phone happy? | It had great reception.
What do you call a snowman in summer? | A puddle.
Why did the sock go to the party? | It wanted to find its sole mate.
Why did the shoe get a gold star? | It put its best foot forward.
Why did the hat get promoted? | It was a real head of the class.
What do you call a bee that cannot make up its mind? | A maybe.
